ctx.x: After that -- now this is what leads up to the Louie Armstrong thing. After I had worked with Joe Glaser on the Street and did such a great job down there, he wanted --
He and I became real good friends then, you know. I used to meet him and we to go walk with -- Ed Sullivan (inaudible).
